title: cosmos palette
description: One palette of the show's library: the source timelines and template sets copy by name, and Studio keeps in step.

kind.description: "klights.palette" -- it says which format the file is

id.description: lower-case letters, digits, '-' and '_', starting with a letter or digit, at most 64 characters. It is also the file name

name.description: the name timelines and template sets know it by, e.g. "Hot"

version.description: Format version. Current is 1; a file with no version is treated as 1.
